bio: Spoil yourself to a sumptuous Afternoon Tea at the Hogs Back Hotel & Spa. This charming hotel provides the ideal environment in which diners can indulge in the great British tradition.  The main restaurant features a modern décor where guests can enjoy a selection of sweet and savoury treats in a welcoming and peaceful atmosphere. If the weather is permitting, guests can enjoy Afternoon Tea in the outdoor seating area.  The Hogs Back Hotel is nestled between Farnham and Guildford in peaceful and picturesque surroundings. It is just a short drive away from Farnham and Guildford's railway stations.
